name: Ancita
source:
Department of Nutrition and Food Sciences; Raccoon

A kind-hearted student whose only wish is to cook and make sure others are well-fed.

She loves to cook for others, but the fact that some are suspicious of the raccoon markings around her eyes saddens her a bit.
